collections.title: Wind and waves
collections.description: Hourly significant wave height, wave direction and 10 m wind from the MET Norway wave model (NetCDF), and ECMWF forecasts (from GRIB2) for the study period.

collections.title: Reference layers
collections.description: Land mask (Shapefile) and fixed offshore structures (GeoParquet) used to keep detections at sea.

collections.title: Sentinel-1 calibrated radar backscatter
collections.description: Calibrated, noise-corrected and terrain-corrected Sentinel-1 IW GRD backscatter (sigma0, VV and VH) over the study area, 20 m, cloud-optimized GeoTIFF.

collections.title: Sentinel-2 cloud cover over sea
collections.description: Cloud mask from the Sentinel-2 L2A scene classification and a true-color preview per acquisition day, mosaicked over the study area.

collections.title: Sentinel-3 sea surface temperature
collections.description: Sentinel-3 SLSTR L2 sea surface temperature cropped to the study area, CF NetCDF with a cloud-optimized GeoTIFF preview.

collections.title: Radar ship detections
collections.description: Bright objects at sea found by the CFAR detector in each Sentinel-1 pass, with shape, brightness, AIS match, sea state, ship probability and estimated length (GeoParquet).
